| # Supported UDS services {#supported-uds-services-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                                                     |                                                                                                                                                              |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

To enable efficient communication, diagnosis, and reprogramming of the device, CB-ME supports specific UDS services. These include:

- Diagnostic and communication management\
 

  SID    Diagnostic Service         Description
  ------ -------------------------- -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  0x10   DiagnosticSessionControl   request to control a diagnostic session with a ECU.
  0x11   ECUReset                   force the ECU to perform a reset.
  0x27   SecurityAccess             request to unlock a secured ECU.
  0x28   CommunicationControl       control the setting of communication parameters in the ECU (e.g. communication baudrate).
  0x3E   TesterPresent              indicate to the ECU that it is still present.
  0x85   ControlDTCSetting          control the setting of DTCs in the server.

- Data transmission\
 

  SID    Diagnostic Service      Description
  ------ ----------------------- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  0x22   ReadDataByIdentifier    request to read the current value of a record identified by a provided dataIdentifier.
  0x2E   WriteDataByIdentifier   request to write a record specified by a provided dataIdentifier.

- Routine\
 

  SID    Diagnostic Service   Description
  ------ -------------------- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  0x31   RoutineControl       requests to start, stop a routine in the server(s) or request the routine results.

- Upload Download\
 

  SID    Diagnostic Services   Description
  ------ --------------------- ------------------------------------------------------------------------
  0x34   RequestDownload       request the negotiation of a data transfer from the tester to the ECU.
  0x36   TransferData          transmit data to or request data from the ECU.
  0x37   RequestTransferExit   request the termination of a data transfer.

- Rexroth-specific

 

  SID    Diagnostic Services   Description
  ------ --------------------- ------------------------
  0xBE   PasswordService       change or set password

 

The details and sub-functions of UDS services important for software flashing are described in the Flashing Reference RC/40 Family (refer Flashing_Reference_RC40-Family_250616 onwards).
